Mountain Activities

Make memories while exploring the natural beauty of Igbaras.

MT.NAPULAK

The most prominent and iconic peak in the municipality, famous for the large nipple-shaped limestone rock formation at its summit.The most prominent and iconic peak in the municipality, famous for the large nipple-shaped limestone rock formation at its summit.

MT.OPAO

A challenging, steep, and scenic trail popular for major climbs and multi-mountain circuits.

MT.TARIPIS

The highest peak in Igbaras, offering sweeping panoramic views of the surrounding mountain ranges.

MT.IGATMON

Located in Brgy. Tigbanaba, it features a more demanding trail rated around difficulty 6/9.

MT.IGMATINDOG

Also located in Brgy. Igcabugao, offering a relatively shorter and direct hike.

Travel responsibly: Coordinate with the local tourism office or accredited guides before visiting mountain destinations.
